title: Avalanche Team1 Mini Grants
description: Team1's open grant for early-stage builders and community initiatives on Avalanche: up to $10,000 in funding, for new and established projects, community builders, developers and unique ideas. Global and ongoing; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

eligibility.note: a project or community initiative for the Avalanche ecosystem

setup: sign in to the Avalanche Builder Hub
each_time: a summary, milestones and why you deserve a grant
rules: Open application: the entry point for early-stage builders and community initiatives.
For new and established projects, community builders, developers and unique ideas.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Requested amount: whole dollars, at most $10,000 USD.
Prior Foundation funding counts as a factor, but it won't close the door on you.
High volume of applications and participation does not guarantee funding.
